_comment: Config of the external attack campaign orchestrator (security/external/campaign.py). Families run in the order of the rules of engagement (docs/en/external-attack-campaigns.md); denial of service is last. 'driver' families are run by campaign.py; 'manual' families (active DAST, DoS) are run by hand in the window and their reports read if present; the supply-chain guards are enforced in mairie360/CICD. The controls table mirrors the external-exposure controls E-01..E-13 of the security policy: its state column is the honest state after this epic, which adds the testing campaign, the monthly reconnaissance and the incident runbook, and does NOT by itself implement the defences E-01/E-02/E-03/E-06.

families.label: Reconnaissance
families.criterion: no deviation from expected.json (ports, subdomains, banners, admin, leaks, DNS, mail)

families.label: Authentication, sessions and tokens
families.criterion: progressive per-IP and per-account block, uniform responses, every invalid token refused

families.label: Access control
families.criterion: 403/401 out of the matrix, no other account's data in a response

families.label: Active scan (injection, browser-side, server-side)
families.criterion: no High alert; each Medium a finding; errors without technical detail

families.label: Business logic and no-session abuse
families.criterion: every business rule holds server-side, an e-mail cap per account and per IP

families.label: Supply chain
families.criterion: enforced in mairie360/CICD (zizmor blocking, guard tests); no secret read nor workflow modified from a fork, unsigned image refused

families.label: Application denial of service
families.criterion: 429/413 not 5xx, no pod restarted, memory under limit, legit p95 under threshold, self-recovery

controls.control: Rate limit par IP et par compte, ingress et services
controls.state: Partiel (pas à l'ingress) ; testé par la campagne DoS

controls.control: Taille de corps, délais et connexions bornés à l'ingress
controls.state: Partiel ; testé par la campagne DoS

controls.control: Requêtes et limites de ressources par pod
Blocage progressif après échecs de connexion
controls.state: Testé par les scénarios d'authentification ; à valider par la 1re campagne

controls.control: Campagne de déni de service applicatif sur staging
Procédure de réponse à une attaque
controls.state: En place : runbook et coupures testées
Outillage livré (mesuré par la campagne) ; à valider

controls.control: Campagne d'attaque externe trimestrielle (boîte noire et grise)
controls.state: En place : orchestrateur et planification ; 1re campagne à jouer

controls.control: DNS et e-mail : SPF, DKIM, DMARC stricts
Aucune interface d'administration joignable depuis Internet
controls.state: Partiel (n8n ouvert) ; vérifié par la reconnaissance
